title: Indonesian Cosmetics Intelligence
description: Monitor targeted cosmetics records in the public BPOM registry and optionally detect new or changed records across runs.

brands.title: Brands to monitor
brands.description: One or more cosmetics brands to search in the BPOM registry. Each brand is queried separately.

registrants.title: Registrants / companies
registrants.description: Optional BPOM registrant/company names to monitor.

registrationNumbers.title: Registration numbers (NIE)
registrationNumbers.description: Optional exact or partial BPOM registration numbers.

compositions.title: Composition keywords
compositions.description: Optional composition/ingredient keywords supported by the BPOM filter.

maxItemsPerQuery.title: Maximum results per query
maxItemsPerQuery.description: Safety and cost limit for each brand/company/product/filter query.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Maximum pages per query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Maximum BPOM pagination pages visited for each query.

includeDetails.title: Open product details
includeDetails.description: Attempt to open the BPOM product detail modal for richer fields. This is slower and more sensitive to UI changes.

detectChanges.title: Detect changes across runs
detectChanges.description: Compare current records with a persistent snapshot stored in a named Key-Value Store.

emit.title: Records to output
emit.description: all = every current record; changes = NEW or CHANGED only; new = only NEW records.

stateStoreName.title: State store name
stateStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store used to persist fingerprints between runs.

stateKey.title: Watchlist state key
stateKey.description: Use a different key for independent monitoring watchlists.

requestDelayMs.title: Delay between interactions (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Small delay used to reduce request pressure on the public source.

debug.title: Save debug artifacts
debug.description: Save HTML and screenshots to the default Key-Value Store if a query cannot be parsed.
